text: Microsoft reported improving Microsoft 365 availability after a multiregional outage exceeding 20 hours. Email queues approahced normal levels as engineers restored servers in stages and extended delayed-message retries to 48 hours. Outlook and connected services remained intermittently disrupted.

meta.note: Queue normalization does not establish full restoration; Microsoft reported no detected malicious activity.

text: Treasury Secretary Bessent said Treasury, Defense, State, and USTR supported restricting Megaspeed for months, while Commerce retained listing authority. He questioned Nvidia's export compliance amid alleged chip diversion to China. Congressional committees requested testimony from Nvidia and Commerce officials.

meta.note: Alleged chip diversion and internal disputes remain unadjudicated; Commerce denied the reported Situation Room exchange.

text: October PPI rose 0.3% monthly versus 0.4% expected, while core PPI increased 0.3%. Annual headline inflation reached 6.5%, with final-demand goods up 10.2% and processed intermediate goods up 14.6%. Prices excluding food, energy, and trade services rose 0.5% monthly.

meta.note: Monthly headline inflation undershot consensus; annual and intermediate-goods measures reflect different comparison periods.

text: The FAA lifted a nationwide ground stop at 8:15 p.m. ET after more than four hours. Overloaded telecommunications routers disrupted multiple air traffic control centers, affecting more than 10,000 flights. Departures resumed amid continuing cancellations, diversions, and operational backlogs.

meta.note: Officials reported no indication of a cyberattack; the technical investigation remains open.
